title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1971-08-15
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT; Transfer Info: DAT > Sony D8 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Upgrade of existing sources. No shn or CDR in lineage. Transferred, tracked and mastered by Bill Guarneri, August 7, 2014

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1971 show captured on a surprisingly clear soundboard recording, highlighted by a standout Rider performance.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers agree this is a very good 1971 Dead concert – the band delivers their usual “shoot‑em‑up” energy and the song Rider gets special praise. The source, a soundboard (SBD) tape that Bill Guaneri has cleaned up, sounds remarkably clear for its era, making the set easy to enjoy even if it doesn’t quite eclipse the previous night’s show.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are favorable (average 4.33★). Recording quality is praised as unusually clear for a ’71 SBD, and the performance is described as very good with notable moments, justifying a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound is “unbelievable” for a 1971 tape and commend Bill Guaneri’s subtle source improvements, indicating clear, balanced audio with minimal vintage muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical 1971 high‑energy flow with a “shoot‑em‑up” feel; solid throughout despite being slightly eclipsed by the previous night’s performance.
